ruling: - **R44. Child repos follow claude-settings, with cited exceptions only.** Owner 14:05 CST Nov 11: "on r44 yea agreed A build all 3". Owner 13:57 CST Nov 11: "i don't want it to be that the repoos like Q_max have adopted a ton of old rules and they just stick in them and claude-settings comes and is unable to bring that lift immediately". Read 13:58 CST: the mandate exists (decision session-tiers, Child repos, owner 2026-11-02 14:02 CST: a child contradicts a parent line only where it cites it as a known exemption, with the owner's grant). What enforces it: probe group restates catches copied record text only; skill compliance-check runs only when asked; claude-settings actions in child CI are pinned and move only when a session notices (decision action-pins-follow-sessions, which names seven pins that drift unseen). That decision's "no bot, no schedule" leaned on the timer ban that 3.15 relaxed. Nothing flags a child line that contradicts a parent rule without an exemption. Step child-repo-gap ("Check how far each child repo is from claude-settings main") has been todo since Oct 29 with no lane; R44 folds into it. Owner 14:03 CST: "audits feel more like one-timey than they are mechanical ... i'd allow for example one quick scan of a part of q_max". Scan 14:04 CST (q_max 32d4373, CLAUDE.md and workflow pins): its CLAUDE.md cites the parent by rule id, as it should. All 9 claude-settings action pins sit at 2ac382cc6 (Nov 8 20:50 CST), 2758 commits behind main, with 50 commits to actions/ since. Its records D-499 and D-833 make the pinned STE sentence-length lint its own law ("npm run lint runs the same lint, at the same pinned commit"), so R37's retirement of that cap will not reach q_max. Its own exception, D-705 (merge over a red browser.yml run, owner 2026-11-07 13:13 CST), cites a grant with a time but not the parent rule it departs from. 1. Child CI runs claude-settings actions from the stable branch of R42 part 2, not a commit pin, so each tested change reaches every child at once. 2. The split: skill compliance-check is the one-time sweep that brings a repo in line; a check in child CI keeps it there. The check flags a contradicting line with no exemption line, and pins move when claude-settings main changes an action. 3. shiv-stylisms content (are its 23 rules still right) joins R35's review, which the owner signs.
